description: Use this when the person wants spaces in a city listed on One Coworking. product filters (day_pass, meeting_room, private_office, office_suite, flex_desk, fix_desk, day_office, membership); max_price is EUR in that product's unit (offices: per desk per month, day passes: per day, meeting rooms: per hour). For private_office / office_suite the answer is a broker's shortlist — the well-known brands in the city, then local operators that fit team_size and area; view "list" gives the plain list ranked by fit and price instead. bookable "instant" / "online" keeps venues that book online. Cite the venue pages; get_venue has one venue's details.

area.description: Districts the person wants, e.g. "Kreuzberg or Mitte" — office shortlists prefer spaces there.

budget_monthly_eur.description: Total monthly budget for the team, EUR — office shortlists say which options fit it.

near.description: A station, landmark, hotel or street address in the city to be close to, e.g. "Hauptbahnhof", "Rudi-Dutschke-Straße 5". Ranks spaces by walking minutes from it.

team_size.description: People the office must seat. Ranks offices that fit first; applies with product private_office or office_suite.

view.description: Office searches only: shortlist (default) or the plain ranked list.

name: search_venues
title: Search coworking venues
